{{Short description|American mathematician}}
[[File:S M Shah.png|thumb|S. M. Shah at retirement, U of Ky, Lexington, KY, May, 1976]]
{{Use dmy dates|date=July 2019}}
'''Swarupchand Mohanlal Shah''' (30 December 1905 – 21 April 1996)<ref name="frse">[http://www.royalsoced.org.uk/cms/files/fellows/lists/deaths.pdf Deceased fellows], Royal Society of Edinburgh, retrieved 2015-02-25.</ref><ref name="ams"/> was a Distinguished Professor of Mathematics at the [[University of Kentucky]].<ref name="ams">{{citation|title=Deaths|department=Mathematics People|journal=Notices of the American Mathematical Society|date=August 1996|page=877|url=http://www.ams.org/notices/199608/people.pdf|volume=43|issue=8}}.</ref><ref>{{citation|url=http://kdl.kyvl.org/catalog/xt73j960633j_39_49|title=Shah, Swarupchand M.|date=1983|work=Portrait collection|publisher=University of Kentucky|accessdate=2015-02-25}}.</ref> He received his Ph.D. from [[University of London]] in 1942, advised by [[Edward Titchmarsh]] who was a Ph.D. student of [[G. H. Hardy]].<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=6882}}</ref> He was a [[fellow]] of the [[Royal Society of Edinburgh]].<ref name="frse"/>

==Selected publications==
* "Advanced differential equations with piecewise constant argument deviations", SM Shah, J Wiener, International Journal of Mathematics and Mathematical ..., 1983, hindawi.com
* "Univalent functions with univalent derivatives", SM Shah, SY Trimble, ''Bulletin of the American Mathematical Society'', 1969, ams.org
* "Trigonometric series with quasi-monotone coefficients", SM Shah, [[Proceedings of the American Mathematical Society]], 1962, jstor.org
